test_ctc_criterion: test the CTC criterion by composing a CTC graph with emissions and computing forward loss
test_asg_criterion: test the ASG criterion by composing emissions, transitions, and FAL graphs then computing loss
test_asg_viterbi_path: test the Viterbi path by composing emissions and transitions graphs and extracting the best path labels
create_emissions_graph: create a linear emissions graph from a flat weight vector with optional log-probability conversion
create_ctc_graph: create a CTC lattice graph from a target label sequence and a blank token index
